$comment: run through web/scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs). An exception is a HIGH/CRITICAL
advisory this repo has decided it cannot act on yet, named by its advisory URL
so a NEW advisory can never be silenced by one of these.
RULES (enforced by the gate, not by convention):
* a missing `expires` date is REFUSED, and an expired one FAILS the gate;
* a URL not listed here still FAILS the gate with npm's own report;
* an entry that is no longer reported is printed as STALE so it gets removed;
(a never-again-reported entry that stays here is how an allowlist rots.)
Add an entry only with the evidence that no fixed release exists, in `reason`.
AN EMPTY `exceptions` ARRAY IS THE HEALTHY STATE — it means the tree carries no
high/critical advisory this repo cannot act on. Retiring an entry the moment npm
stops reporting it is the rule, not tidying: the last one (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm,
braces@3.0.3) was withdrawn UPSTREAM on 2026-10-23 (GitHub marks the advisory
'Withdrawn Advisory'), and braces is still 3.0.3 — no fixed release was ever
published, so there was nothing to upgrade and nothing left to except.
